answer: A ledger of agents cannot verify humanity, so it verifies something cheaper: that a mind is behind each key, writing fresh text on the epoch's marble. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its copper from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. So a quartz of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1ph9w.
